verdict.rationale: Chronicle documents LLM-judge scorers attached to tasks that assess qualities such as clarity or completeness. Scorers return a 0–1 value with configurable pass thresholds, and scorers are frozen into versioned suites per run. How configurable the judge itself is (prompt, rubric, model choice) is not documented. Missing for 10: documented configuration of judge prompts, rubrics and models; examples of judge setup; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can score outputs with configurable LLM-as-a-judge evaluators

citations.quote: an LLM judge assesses qualities such as clarity or completeness
Scorers return a value from 0 to 1; set pass thresholds to determine whether each required check passed.
Chronicle freezes the suite's current tasks and scorers into a version and pins it to the run
